rule: After production, lead-loss, incorrect-data and broken-user-journey emergencies, finish the approved Search3 design across the site, publish a coherent preview, verify the user journey and prepare a reversible migration. Production draft #1334 must not merge or deploy until explicit owner visual approval of the concrete release. Preview publishing and draft preparation are authorized. Preserve AnyTour Design System 2.0, logo, Tourvisor/API contract, price arithmetic, lead transport/field mapping, Metrika/goals and repository isolation. Keep technical refactor and mass SEO expansion deferred. Do not invent benefits, operating hours or legal/payment terms.

scoped_refactor_authorization.scope: Search3 presentation source ownership and reproducible build; preserve served behavior, cascade order and protected contracts

required: exact artifact build and focused presentation/source checks
verification_policy.restore: ready_for_review event on each affected workflow; production approval still required
verification_policy.live: One focused live scenario per published batch; mobile/desktop if layout changed

working_code_draft: one exact artifact build (including PHP/path/presentation/isolation checks)
ci_execution.artifact_reuse: Keep the successful working-PR source artifact after release fast-forward and documentation checkpoints; do not rebuild or redeploy docs.
ci_execution.restoration: Non-draft PRs restore all applicable workflows on ready_for_review.
